title: Sum of Proper Divisors

content.problemStatement: Find the sum of factors of the given number.

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input produces the corresponding formatted output according to problem rules.

solution.approach: Find the sum of all positive divisors of n.
solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: Iterate up to sqrt(n) and sum each divisor pair (i and n / i).

hints: If i divides n, add both i and n/i.
Avoid adding sqrt(n) twice if perfect square.
